summary: SDK-level field that sets the `anthropic-beta` request header. Each beta feature above names the header it needs.
combines: Supported on: all models; individual betas have their own model lists

`interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14` enables thinking between tool calls in manual mode on Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, and earlier Claude 4 models, and is deprecated-but-working on Sonnet 4.6. Opus 4.6 has no manual-mode interleaving at all. Haiku 4.5 does not support interleaved thinking; the header is accepted and ignored.
Adaptive thinking interleaves automatically with no header on Fable 5, Mythos 5, Mythos Preview, Opus 5, Opus 4.8, and Opus 4.7.
The Claude API and Claude Platform on AWS accept the interleaved header on any model and ignore it where it has no effect; Bedrock and Google Cloud likewise accept and ignore.
